decks.notes: The deck focuses on stopping the opponent's plans with counterspells and disruption, while setting up the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat quickly. The deck aims to control the game early on with cards like Portent and Vision Charm, while using cards like Meddling Mage to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing efficient spells and a powerful combo, the deck aims to overpower the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get out a Phyrexian Dreadnought and protect it with Stifle and other counter spells. By using cards like Gush and Foil to draw into your combo pieces, while utilizing cantrips like Opt and Impulse, you can assemble your combo as fast as possible. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Daze and Chain of Vapor to help control the game until you can execute your combo. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a large threat that they struggles to deal with.

The focus of this deck is on maintaining control of the game by utilizing various removal spells and disruptive cards to hinder the opponent's strategy. By leveraging cards like Smother, Engineered Plague, and Contamination, the deck aims to keep the opponent's board clear while building up its own resources through cards like Skeletal Scrying and Zombie Infestation. The inclusion of disruption spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy further adds to the deck's ability to disrupt the opponent's plans, ultimately leading to a victory through attrition and control of the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent through a combination of low-cost creatures and burn spells. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, while also utilizing powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Grim Lavamancer and Sulfuric Vortex helps to maintain pressure on the opponent and prevent them from stabilizing. Overall, the deck is designed to be fast and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board while maintaining card advantage through cards like Standstill and Fact or Fiction. By utilizing counterspells and removal spells, the player aims to disrupt their opponent's game plan and stall the game until they can win through efficient threats like Mishra's Factory and Decree of Justice. The deck also has utility lands like Dust Bowl to further disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through efficient control strategies.

The focus of this deck is on dealing direct damage to the opponent quickly and efficiently. It utilizes aggressive creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast. The goal is to put pressure on the opponent early and prevent them from stabilizing, ultimately burning them out before they can mount a strong defense. The inclusion of cards like Sulfuric Vortex helps to ensure a steady stream of damage, while cards like Cursed Scroll provide additional reach to finish off the opponent.

This Aggro White Weenie deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, efficient creatures like Savannah Lions, Soltari Priest, and Silver Knight. With support cards like Mother of Runes and Swords to Plowshares for protection and removal, the deck aims to control the board and maintain pressure. Armageddon disrupts the opponent's resources, while cards like Disenchant and Seal of Cleansing handle any problematic artifacts or enchantments. The deck's simplicity and speed make it a powerful force in the early game, forcing opponents to react quickly or risk being overrun.

The main idea of this Mono Red Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's resources and board state through targeted land destruction and burn spells, while utilizing cards like Pyrokinesis, Cursed Scroll, and Grim Lavamancer to control the game. The deck aims to stay ahead on board presence by efficiently dealing damage and preventing the opponent from stabilizing. With a focus on resource denial and aggression, the deck aims to control the game and close out matches quickly with powerful burn spells and creature threats.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through disruption and resource denial, while also utilizing the powerful Oath of Druids card as a win condition. The deck aims to slow down the opponent with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Winter's Grasp, while also maintaining card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library. The main win condition is to use Oath of Druids to put a Terravore onto the battlefield, which can quickly close out the game with its power and abilities. The mana base is designed to support the deck's strategy and provide flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on using a combination of creatures and control cards to manipulate the board state in order to outlast and overpower the opponent. By utilizing cards like Survival of the Fittest and Natural Order to tutor for key creatures, along with cards like Winter Orb and Opposition to disrupt the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to maintain board advantage and control until it can secure the win. The deck's strategy revolves around resource management and strategic decision-making to outplay the opponent and emerge victorious in the match.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with low-cost creatures and burn spells to deal direct damage to the opponent. It aims to control the board and end the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. By using efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, this deck puts pressure on the opponent early and often. The inclusion of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Price of Progress also punishes opponents for playing nonbasic lands, further accelerating the pace of the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent by playing low-cost, highly aggressive creatures and burning spells. The goal is to deal damage as quickly as possible to the opponent's life total, while also having some staying power with cards like Sulfuric Vortex. The deck utilizes a low land count and high-density burn spells to keep the pressure on the opponent and finish them off before they can stabilize. The strategy is to be relentless and unrelenting in dealing damage, aiming for a swift victory.

The deck focuses on creating a lock with the Stasis enchantment, preventing opponents from untapping their permanents. Utilizing cards like Gush and Chain of Vapor to keep the Stasis lock in place while controlling the opponent's resources through spells like Counterspell and Daze. The inclusion of cards like Black Vise and Propaganda adds additional pressure on the opponent, forcing them to make difficult decisions. With a strong control game plan and the ability to combo off with cards like Forsaken City, the deck aims to grind out victories through attrition and tempo advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game with a mix of creature removal, hand disruption, and strong creatures like Ravenous Baloth and Blastoderm. The deck also utilizes cards like Pernicious Deed and Recurring Nightmare to maintain board presence and control threats. The inclusion of options like Living Wish allows for flexibility in finding key cards from the sideboard. The mana base is designed to support the deck's strategy, with a mix of green and black sources alongside utility lands like Treetop Village and Dust Bowl.
